message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Validate

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 0 * * *"
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

permissions: {}

jobs:
  hassfest: # https://developers.home-assistant.io/blog/2020/04/16/hassfest
    name: Hassfest Validation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Run hassfest validation
        uses: home-assistant/actions/hassfest@master

  hacs: # https://github.com/hacs/action
    name: HACS Validation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Run HACS validation
        uses: hacs/action@main
        with:
          category: integration

  test:
    name: Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.14"

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('requirements.txt') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: Install requirements
        run: scripts/setup

      - name: Run
        run: pytest

  test-minimum:
    name: Tests (minimum Home Assistant version)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

      # pytest-homeassistant exists only from Home Assistant 2026.11, so this job
      # uses the discontinued pytest-homeassistant-custom-component.
      # 0.13.272 pins Home Assistant 2025.8.3, the minimum in hacs.json.
      # pycares 5 is incompatible with the aiodns version of that release.
      - name: Install requirements
        run: python3 -m pip install "pytest-homeassistant-custom-component==0.13.272" "pycares<5"

      # Coverage is checked by the "Tests" job (some code runs only on newer versions).
      - name: Run
        run: pytest --no-cov",
  "rationale": "The workflow's test jobs repeatedly fetch Python dependencies on every run with no dependency cache, while the repository has a requirements.txt and a history of repeated scheduled runs, satisfying the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE preconditions (repeated dependency fetching is measurable; cache input is a lockfile/dependency file). Adding a standard actions/cache@v4 pip dependency cache before installation, keyed on requirements.txt with a restore fallback, preserves all existing jobs, steps, tests, and coverage (permissions stay empty, no new secrets, network, or privileged actions) and only reduces redundant dependency downloads on warm runs.",
  "evidence_ids": ["P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
